messages.en:
{07 14 00}I love redecorating because
it changes the way my room
feels so much!
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Sad breakups make a
place more beautiful{01 00 00 14 00} but
it's a high price to pay.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Armastan ümber sisustada,
sest see muudab mu toa
tunnet nii väga!
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Kurvad lahkuminekud teevad
koha ilusamaks{01 00 00 14 00}, aga
see on kõrge hind.

messages.en:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I dated a boy who was a
total furniture freak,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}For some stupid reason, I'm
reminiscing about him.{01 00 00 05 00}
I have no idea why{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}I'm such an idiot{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Why
can't I just forget him and
his matching end tables?!
messages.et:
{07 1c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Ma käisin poisiga, kes oli
täielik mööblihull,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 15 00}Mingil rumalal põhjusel
meenutan teda.{01 00 00 05 00}
Ei tea, miks{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Milline idioot ma olen{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Miks
ma ei suuda teda ja ta
sobivaid öökappe unustada?!

messages.en:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Your reflection at midnight
is what you'll look like in
ten years.
I read that somewhere. {07 02 00}But!{01 01 00}
{07 08 00}I don't want to know{01 00 00 05 00} what
I'll look like in ten years!
messages.et:
{07 0e 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Su peegelpilt keskööl
näitab, milline sa oled
kümne aasta pärast.
Lugesin seda kusagilt. {07 02 00}Aga!{01 01 00}
{07 08 00}Ma ei taha teada{01 00 00 05 00}, milline ma
kümne aasta pärast olen!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}He plays at the {ff 00 00 08}Roost {ff 00 00 00}every
Saturday!{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 13 00} Oh, he writes the
dreamiest songs!
{07 19 00}I think he's got a pretty
strong following, too,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{07 00 00}
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ta mängib {ff 00 00 08}Roostis {ff 00 00 00}igal
laupäeval!{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 13 00} Oh, ta kirjutab
kõige imelisemaid laule!
{07 19 00}Arvan, et tal on ka päris
tugev fännkond,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!{07 00 00}

messages.en:
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Take chairs.{01 01 00} I like 'em best
with armrests, {07 14 00}fancy
fabric, and gold fringe{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0d 00}I want to sit in a chair{01 00 00 05 00},
no, a THRONE, like that
just once!
messages.et:
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Võta toolid.{01 01 00} Mulle meeldivad
need käetugedega, {07 14 00}peene
kanga ja kuldnarmastega{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 0d 00}Tahan kasvõi korra istuda{01 00 00 05 00}
sellises toolis, ei,
TROONIL!

messages.en:
{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Take wardrobes, for
example.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Or should I say
garment rooms?
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}You see, right now all my
haute couture dresses are{01 00 00 0a 00}
crowding my house.
{07 00 00}Of course,{01 00 00 05 00} they're all gifts
from you-know-who,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Võta näiteks
riidekapid.{01 00 00 14 00} {07 14 00}Või ütleksin
rõivatoad?
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Näed, praegu on kõik mu
kõrgmoe kleidid{01 00 00 0a 00}
mu maja ummistanud.
{07 00 00}Muidugi{01 00 00 05 00} on need kõik kingid
kelleltki-sa-tead,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Take beds, for example.{01 01 00}
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Poorly made ones are flat
and have no support, right?
{07 00 00}I want to sleep{01 00 00 05 00}
in a bed that envelopes me
like a cloud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Like a bed for a queen,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 0c 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Võta näiteks voodid.{01 01 00}
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Halvasti tehtud on lamedad
ja ei toeta midagi, eks?
{07 00 00}Ma tahan magada{01 00 00 05 00}
voodis, mis mähib mind
nagu pilv, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Nagu kuninganna voodi,
{01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Rather than looking at the
big picture,{01 00 00 0a 00} I focus on
individual pieces.
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}That's one of the many
things{01 00 00 05 00} I love about myself.{01 00 00 0a 00}
My attention to detail!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Selle asemel, et vaadata
suurt pilti,{01 00 00 0a 00} keskendun ma
üksikutele esemetele.
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}See on üks paljudest
asjadest,{01 00 00 05 00} mida enda juures
armastan.{01 00 00 0a 00} Minu detailitaju!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} If you find 
some cool furniture, pick
some up for me, all right?
{07 00 00}I'm kidding!{01 00 00 05 00} I'm just
teasing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! I
mean, kind of.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}In this world, {01 00 00 05 00}some people
want to nurture and others
want to BE nurtured.
messages.et:
{07 06 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Kui leiad
lahedat mööblit, võta
mullegi, eks?
{07 00 00}Ma teen nalja!{01 00 00 05 00} Ma lihtsalt
narrin, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}! Noh,
mingis mõttes.
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}Selles maailmas {01 00 00 05 00}tahavad
ühed hoolitseda ja teised
tahavad hoolt saada.

messages.en:
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}When you find the right
furniture, it feels like it
was just meant to be{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 19 00}Take my table, for example.
The first time I saw it, I
knew it was fate.
{07 15 00}Why don't relationships ever
turn out that way,
{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}Kui leiad õige mööbli,
tundub, nagu oleks see
niimoodi määratud{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 19 00}Võta näiteks mu laud.
Kui ma seda esimest korda
nägin, teadsin: see on
saatus. {07 15 00}Miks suhted kunagi
nii ei lähe,
{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
When I picture my dream
chair, {07 13 00}{01 00 00 0a 00}I'm sitting in it and
sipping {04 13 00}{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{01 00 00 0a 00}{07 1b 00}{01 00 00 05 00}Visualization is very
important when buying
furniture, {01 00 00 0a 00}{04 02 00}.
